info.name: English Meaning
info.value: to be thoroughly prepared,to be accomplished,to be achieved, to be ready

info.name: DAturUpanandinIwippaRI
info.value: saMrAdDiH = vipattiH . ' siDeH siDyati saMrAdDO ' (Slo. 116) iti devaH . saMrAdDiH nizpattiH . ' kecidUditaM paWanti . tadasat . anudAttopadeSavEyarTyAt ' iti mADavaH .

examples: 'BUtaM BavyaM BavizyaM ca sarvaM vedAt prasiDyati' (manu॰12.97). prasiDyati praBavati prAdurBavati.
'taTEkavfttitA tayoH svaraSca me prasiDyati' (pA॰3.1.122 ityatra Slo॰vA0). prasiDyati vyaktimeti, vyAKyAto Bavati.
'na prasiDyanti karmARi kriyatAmavicAraRAt' (hari0 2.51.21). prasiDyanti siDyanti. anarTakaH praSabdaH. kriyatAM kurvatAm.
'tAByAM yuktvA prAseDat na udajayat' (paYca0 brA0 14.3.13). prAseDat prAgacCat prAtizWata.
'etO me gAvO pramarasya yuktO mo zu pra seDIrmuhurinmamanDi' (f0 10.27.20). mA praseDIH=mA sma apAjaH, mA'pagamaya.
'japyenEva tu saMsiDyed brAhmaRo nAtra saMSayaH' (manu0 2.87). saMsiDyet=apavargamApnuyAt. paramAnandaM vindet.
'saMsiDyasva mahAbAho kuru kAryamanantaram' (BA0 vana0 368.34). kftI Bava, kftArTaH syA ityAha.
'AbAlameva saMsidDaM kartuM Saknoti ko'nyaTA' (yo0 vA0 6 (u0) 156.31) saMsidDaM svaBAvajam, sAMsidDikam.
'…saMsidDaM priyarAGavam. sumitrA gacCa gacCeti punaH punaruvAca tam' (rA0 2.408). saMsidDaM gamanodyuktam iti govindarAjaH.
'aTa yadasyAnnamupasidDaM syAt' (go0 gf0 1.9.4). upasidDaM samIpe sidDam.
